name: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
_eligibility_text:
1. A full time regular/permanent faculty members of AICTE recognized Degree Level Colleges.
1. The candidate should possess three years teaching experience at graduate level.  
1. Should have a Master’s degree in the appropriate branch.
1. Should have an admission offer in Ph.D programme from the Foreign University of Listed ranking system in previous five years.
